Title: [LSJ] Direct Intervention vs. Multiple cards played at the same time

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
What happens if Ingrid Rossler declares she is attempting to employ a Dog
Pack with a Beast Meld (both cards played at the same time), and another
Methuselah plays a Direct Intervention on the Dog Pack?. Does the Beast Meld
"fizzle"?.

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No cards are played "at the same time". Everything comes in sequence.
The Dog Pack can be DI'ed "as it is played" (before Beast Meld can be played).
